comparison.objective: Uniformly heat-shrink a sleeve over a cable lug and safely stow the heat gun.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate cable rotation with noncontact heat-tool traversal and exposure control versus contact-based hex/collar manipulation and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Requires all sleeve stations recovered, both ends sealed, no charring or contact, gun off and stowed, and hands clear; no damper setting. Rubric is complete though thermal behavior is a coded approximation.
comparison.reason: Controlled distributed heating is a separate ability from mechanical adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
